Hy… nng!

I don't understand,

Ah, ahh… aha…

Still…

Tightly, tightly…

No, the world is closing in…!?

Don't worry.
I'll take my time and teach you.

This is the center of #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's mind…

A world filled with an anguish that no one
understands, and a sense of hopelessness
that no one tries to see.
#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF has a blank look on her face.

Her passiveness has vanished,
and now she's resolved to let no one pass―――
I sense her madness, to let no one who enters leave.

…if you had stayed in that school…
I was always watching you…
I liked it that way, I was happy, and yet…
Lip and I are enemies.

Enemies… We're enemies……?
What do you mean―that's…
That's a convenient excuse……!

Lies…!
If that were true,
then why did you reject me so many times…!?

What should I have done…? If I could have
forgotten, everything would be fine… but an AI
like me has no "forget" function…

Are you saying there's something
wrong with me…!?

Something wrong, huh?
Praetor, it's her compassion.
Tell it to her straight.

Obviously her body is one issue, but anyway…
Answer her, Master. It seems that she won't
get it unless you say it.

Does this girl even see a reflection in mirrors?
Regardless, you need to be clear, Darling!
Be sincere when you flat out reject her!

Something wrong, hm? Say it, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
Right out of your own mouth, as if bidding her
farewell.
"Those claws damage whatever they touch."

I can't comment on #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's personality.
Like anyone, she has good aspects and bad aspects.
But there is this one thing.

There's no doubt that all those claws
can do is hurt people.
Unless she can take them off, I can't speak to her.

She was on the verge of tears,
but her face transforms into that
of an expressionless Noh mask.

I can no longer see any human-like
emotion in #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's eyes.

#C236196003Lip#CDEF curiously peers at her own hands.
She speaks as if what she sees are normal arms.
It reminds of the fable, "The Emperor's New Clothes."

That's what #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF was made to be;
an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF made to only ever be rejected.

…I see… That's right.
Because I'm an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF…
Because I'm one of #C236196003BB#CDEF's parts…

You're tricking me with lies like
that, aren't you?
…even though… I like you so much…

Even though I like you so much,
I can't go on living without you!

There's no more avoiding fights.
There's nowhere for #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF to run.
The only thing left to do is settle this now.

So, you have love and hate flipped.
I won't sneer at your earnestness. My love is
in a form similar to yours, as well.

Only cherishing things you like―――
That's nothing but a reflection of narcissism.

To compel someone to serve you,
you exhaust them. You accept obligations to
make them obligated to you.

If you find out that it doesn't turn out that
way, you turn them into a mute pebble
and keep them for yourself.

I've had enough of all this "I like you,
I like you." Have you ever once put in any
effort to make yourself likeable?

―――Very well.
At last you've become human, it seems.
I've been waiting for that hatred.

Love is not a beautiful thing.
It's ugly, irrational, and involves pain.

However―――Your love is one-sided.
Love is something you nurture together,
and it changes.

A love which desires only one's partner, a love
which only begs to be desired, only achieves
consuming the life of one's companion.

Taking away even the freedom of those who
distanced themselves from you is nothing short
of an evil obsession.

True love is about give-and-take. Just feeling
isn't enough. The unselfish would say
that you're IN love, but not loving.

And that's why what is born from within that
becomes a light, which anyone would
find difficult to alter.

Love and hate must be a fabric woven of both.
What truth is there in saying there exists
beauty which births only beautiful things?

I shall teach you that lesson.
Come at me, #RUBS      Alter Ego#RUBElittle fraction#REND.
I'll put an end to your suffering!

#C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF, #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF.
Before we settle this, I'll throw you
just one question: is your love genuine?

Your liking is still only on that level.
Go milk those brea― I mean, dust yourself off
and try again.

…though, I guess that's the reason why I
sympathize, or maybe, admire you. If you weren't
after my Darling, I might be cheering you on.

Therefore, the king himself shall teach this:
whatever the endeavor, fundamentally, it's a
battle. Everything has assailants and victims.

If you wish to achieve your lifelong dream,
then kill me, and make #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF yours.
That's all your madness is capable of!

But… Even if an AI wanted to die, they can't.
That's why…
That's why……

Yes, that's the best way…!
If only you never existed… Everything would've
been fine if you never existed…!

maybe I was being intentionally rough with her.

and it hurts… mm…

Now that I'm set on exposing her mind,
I'm going to drive her right up against the wall.

I recklessly insert my hand into her cleavage.
My fingertips touch a number of cubes.

Deep cleavage. An information coffin.
A treasure box that will never open, its contents all rotten.

#C000246204Breast Valley#CDEF.
It shows proof that she's no normal human――no normal maiden.
Without even writhing around, #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF simply bears it.

It hurts, don't…
It's embarrassing, I don't like it…
Ah, mm, ahh!

Ah, d-don't―――DON'T―――!
You'll fall―――you're going to fall into
#RUBS     me  #RUBEmy valley#REND at this rate, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF…!

back to my senses. If she hadn't restrained me with her voice,
I would've probably slipped into her #C000246204Breast Valley#CDEF
and turned into a living lump of flesh.
I slowly release my fingers.

between her words and her seemingly lonely voice.

she blocks herself off with her colossal claws―――

Is the reason why she never has any self-confidence

My words become a blade that tears through #C236196003Lip#CDEF's mind.

#C000246204Masochistic Constitution#CDEF.

beckoning them to act sadistically towards #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF.

Still, when someone, comes near,
I get scared…

I mean, when I'm touched… umm…
My body, starts, hurting…
…starts, getting hot…

…I feel sorry for her, but that's wrong.
#C236196003Lip#CDEF is also at fault here.

reason after being invited in by her #C000246204Masochistic Constitution#CDEF.

Hypersensitivity

I'm going to get to squashing you now, okay?

…I messed up…
Looks like I'm still not in my right state of mind…
#C000246204Hypersensitivity#CDEF.

Even if they had no intention to,
her highly-sensitive body means
they would end up hurting #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF.

Her hands are supposed to match the other's force,
but they flatten and crush anything and everything.
That's everything about this #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF.

She's none other than an incarnation of lust,
saying all those things to avert her eyes
from her own sins―――!

…she's wrong.
Those claws aren't the only thing monster-like about her.

She crushes those who don't live up to her expectations.
She mercilessly makes anything she doesn't need disappear.

I like #C236196003#NICK#CDEF… That's really all
there is to it… I want you, to stay by me,
even if only for a little while…

So… I thought about getting rid of anyone
who got between us… That's all,
what's wrong with that!?
You're saying that's selfish?
…this is bad, we're going nowhere…

There's no point in giving #C236196003Lip#CDEF half-baked arguments.
I need to clearly and fully reject her…!

#C236196003Lip#CDEF talked about getting rid of everyone
who gets in her way―"that's it."
